title: Canonical affine spectrum tensor coordinate data and chain coherence
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ be a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], and suppose their spectrum maps on global sections also form a cartesian square. Fix sheaf derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], a complex $P$ of modules on $X$, $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X',\top)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Put $j=X'.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $z=j(z_0)$, $P_0=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*P$ and $P_g=(g')^*P$ termwise. Write $R,A,B,D$ and $R_0,A_0,B_0,D_0$ for the two sets of four stalk rings and their structural maps [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], $Q=P_{g'(z)}$, $Q_0=(P_0)_{g'_0(z_0)}$, and $V=D\otimes_A Q$, $V_0=D_0\otimes_{A_0}Q_0$ for tensorComplex. There exist ring isomorphisms $e_R,e_A,e_B,e_D$, commuting with the R-to-A and R-to-B maps and satisfying $e_D(\mu(a\otimes b))=\mu_0(e_A(a)\otimes e_B(b))$, and chain isomorphisms $q:Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_A}Q_0$, $t:V\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}V_0$ with $t^k(d\otimes x)=e_D(d)\otimes q^k(x)$. Let F and F0 forget scalars, Fc and F0c be their complex functors, rho the canonical identification of forgotten restriction of scalars, s and s0 the tensorStalkIso maps, Uchain the ordinary pullback-stalk complex comparison along j, and alpha the canonical composition isomorphism. These coordinates satisfy Fc(t);rho;F0c(s0)=Fc(s);Uchain;F0c(stalk(alpha inverse)). This is an equality of chain maps before homology.

proof.text: Obtain the four ring coordinates, q, their ring compatibility equations, and the pure-tensor formula for the fixed additive chain isomorphism H from the generator-coordinate lemma.

In each degree, prove H(r v)=eD(r) H(v) by tensor induction. The zero and sum cases follow from additivity. On d tensor x, scalar multiplication is (r d) tensor x; the generator formula and multiplicativity of eD give eD(r d) tensor q(x)=eD(r) times (eD(d) tensor q(x)). Use ModuleCat.isoMk to lift each additive component isomorphism to a D-linear component isomorphism into restriction of scalars. The differentials commute because H is already a chain map. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents assembles t, whose pure-tensor formula is the generator formula.

After forgetting scalars and using the canonical complex-functor composition identification, the constructed t is H by component extensionality. Postcompose with the spectrum tensorStalkIso. Its inverse in the definition of H cancels, leaving exactly the stated chain coherence equation.

proof_origin.place: B2: construct the linear tensor comparison from the fixed additive comparison using tensor induction; chain compatibility and coherence follow by extensionality and inverse cancellation. Geometric pure-tensor coordinates remain a separate sublemma.
